title: Microsoft presents: Looking ahead: the future of AL-Go and BCContainerHelper

chapters.title: Container Helper maintenance challenges and deprecation date
Vision for agentic engineering and AL-Go for GitHub
Moving Business Central to BC Apps on AL-Go
BC Container Helper deprecation and replacement strategy
BC Container Helper 2 parameters and support timeline
Repository strategy and platform support discussion
Azure DevOps vs GitHub and container performance considerations
PowerShell migration and local development vision

features.name: Container Helper
features.description: A tool that allows running NAV and Business Central in containers for development and verification, launched approximately nine years ago. Over the last week it provisioned more than 75,000 containers, compiled half a million apps and published about a million apps.
caveats: Being deprecated as of October 1st, 2027
Growing unmaintainable over time
Will become community-maintained project after deprecation

features.name: AL-Go for GitHub
features.description: A central platform for CI/CD pipelines, PR builds, and deployment to app stores that is becoming the core of Business Central development. It integrates GitHub capabilities and will be the foundation for agentic engineering features.
caveats: Requires GitHub as platform
Scale considerations for large codebases
GitHub-specific with richer AI integration capabilities

features.name: Workspace compilation
features.description: A compilation mode in AL-Go that accepts a workspace of multiple apps instead of compiling them one at a time, allowing the compiler to figure out dependency trees and compile apps in parallel. Significantly improves compilation time for repositories with many apps.
caveats: Most beneficial with 10+ apps in a repository
Less relevant for small codebases
Only available through AL-Go, not BC Container Helper

features.name: Build hooks in AL-Go
features.description: Customization feature that allows hooking into certain parts of the CI/CD process to run custom scripts. Currently includes build initialize which runs at the beginning of the build, with build finalize coming as well.

features.name: Test-only projects in AL-Go
features.description: A feature that lets you shift compilation to one job and then do all testing in another job, providing a quicker feedback loop during development.

features.name: Code coverage in AL-Go
features.description: A feature being developed for AL-Go that will provide code coverage metrics.
features.status_evidence_quote: Code coverage is one that's coming soon. Automatic reruns on flaky tests

features.name: Automatic reruns on flaky tests
features.description: A feature coming to AL-Go that will automatically retry tests that intermittently fail, with flaky test management in general.
features.status_evidence_quote: Code coverage is one that's coming soon. Automatic reruns on flaky tests and stuff and flaky test management in general.

features.name: Improved incremental builds
features.description: A planned improvement to AL-Go for faster build times by only rebuilding changed components.

features.name: Turn-based testing
features.description: A feature that will run tests based on what parts of the application have changed, avoiding full test suite execution.

features.name: PR reviewer agent
features.description: An agent being developed for AL-Go for GitHub that automatically reviews pull requests. Currently in testing and dogfooding phase with the BC internal engineering team.
caveats: Currently in testing phase
Will be opt-in when released
Currently internal dogfood, not yet available to customers

features.name: BC Container Helper 2 module
features.description: A replacement module focused on core functionality around the life cycle of BC environments, including provisioning containers, deprovisioning, and running scripts inside containers. It will be a separate, independent module available for download.
features.status_evidence_quote: the BC Container Helper will be kind of split apart. Uh for now, we don't have a better name. We call it BC Container
caveats: Name subject to change
Planned for delivery by end of 2026
Will not have full feature parity with BC Container Helper
AppSource submission functionality location still being determined
No plans currently for additional modules beyond two

features.name: BC Apps repository
features.description: An open source repository on GitHub that will contain the entire Business Central application source code including the base app and all associated apps. Moving 15 million lines of AL code and 35,000 AL files, planned for June.
caveats: May reserve some apps while working on announcements
Deadline is June but has already experienced some delays
Consolidates BC apps repo which already has community contributions

features.name: Gradual AL-Go module migration
features.description: Plan to gradually migrate functionality from BC Container Helper into the new AL-Go module over time rather than doing a big bang roll-out, allowing continuous feature addition and evaluation.
caveats: No specific timeline provided
Requires test infrastructure for validation

features.name: Pipeline decomposition
features.description: Plans to break down and thin out the AL-Go pipelines, especially for pull requests, by moving compilation and other operations out of run AL pipeline to improve build times.
caveats: Incremental approach - not all changes at once
Performance gains depend on container provisioning improvements

features.name: Open repository for new BC Container Helper
features.description: Plan to make the new BC Container Helper code available in an open repository as soon as at least one scenario from AL-Go is flowing through the new module and working.
caveats: Availability dependent on having working scenarios
Pre-release branch availability to be determined based on customer needs

features.name: AL Tool
features.description: A standard tool that can be invoked from any pipeline, not tied to GitHub specifically. Works with both GitHub and Azure DevOps pipelines.
caveats: Only AL-Go is GitHub-specific, not AL Tool

features.name: Business Central apps repository consolidation
features.description: Plan to consolidate the open source pilot by making the Business Central app suite repository public, eliminating the need for separate open source and private repositories.
features.status_evidence_quote: the open source pilot will be killed because there will be no need for an open source. It's not a pilot anymore basically.

features.name: Container performance improvements
features.description: Awareness of container deployment slowness in both local environments and build pipelines. Team is aware this is a problem but has no concrete plans yet.
caveats: Performance issues largely due to Windows containers and disk operations, not BC-specific
No concrete timeline

features.name: Linux support for BC Service
features.description: No official plans currently to run the BC service on Linux, though it does run with some hacks. Discussions happening internally about this possibility.
caveats: Missing functionality in Linux compared to Windows
Would benefit AL-Go by making containers faster and cheaper to run
Only runs on Windows officially

features.name: ALOps integration planning
features.description: Regular meetings planned with ALOps team to ensure seamless integration of new AL-Go and BC Container Helper changes with ALOps for Azure DevOps.

features.name: Partner authentication in BC Container Helper pipeline
features.description: Partner teams can use their existing authentication context and refresh tokens to work with multiple customer tenants without creating separate client credentials.

features.name: PowerShell commandlet redesign to use NST APIs
features.description: Core functionality is being moved behind commandlets into the NST itself, making commandlets much slimmer and calling APIs on NST instead of direct implementation.
features.status_evidence_quote: there are some changes coming that actually I'm not probably not officially, but will kind of introduce support for PowerShell 5 again.
caveats: Not officially announced
Not an excuse to avoid moving to PowerShell 7

features.name: Migration to GitHub for agentic engineering
features.description: Microsoft is shifting to GitHub because it has richer functionality and better integration for agentic and AI engineering compared to Azure DevOps out of the box.
caveats: GitHub lacks some Azure DevOps fundamentals like better permission setups

features.name: Local development environment vision
features.description: Future local development will still require local containers for agents to interact with for publishing, running tests, and other development tasks.
caveats: Predicting the future is very hard
Subject to change based on technology evolution

features.name: BCContainerHelper CLI instead of PowerShell module
features.description: BCContainerHelper H2 module will be implemented as a CLI to run everywhere across different environments and runners, rather than as a PowerShell module tied to specific versions.
caveats: Still in development and planning phase
